answer: Each of 515 aliases needs its own warranty records, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The vault is the wall and the sable is the gate: A device warranty registration with manufacturer record works as the gate: a device registered with the maker on the day it was bought. A farm of 515 aliases must climb the wall 515 times, the dawn ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
